summary: Attempted frontend verification of new AdminParasMall Bookings sub-tabs (Pending Delivery / Delivered / All Bookings). Admin login (admin@test.com / PIN 153759) succeeded and redirected to /admin. However, navigating to /admin/mall consistently hangs on the global Suspense LoadingFallback ('Loading…') across multiple attempts (3+ retries, hard reload, Service Worker unregister + cache clear). Two HTTP 403 errors are emitted to the browser console during the load — the lazy-loaded 'admin' webpack chunk (containing AdminParasMall) is being blocked. As a result the [data-testid="admin-paras-mall"] root never mounts and NONE of the new sub-tab UI elements (sub-tabs, count badges, empty-state, parent pending badge, hint banner, Mark Delivered button visibility, default-tab styling) could be exercised end-to-end. Code review of /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin/AdminParasMall.js shows the implementation matches the spec (default state 'pending_delivery', derived filtered lists, sub-tab pills with correct testids and active colours bg-amber-500 / bg-blue-600 / bg-slate-700, hint banner only on pending tab, parent pending badge with animate-pulse + bg-amber-400, empty-state with three distinct messages, Mark Delivered button gated on b.status==='fulfilled'). Logic looks correct on static review but live verification is BLOCKED by the chunk 403.

ui_bugs.issue: Page never renders — lazy admin chunk returns HTTP 403, Suspense fallback 'Loading…' hangs indefinitely. Reproduced across SW-unregister + cache-clear + hard reload. Blocks ALL admin mall functionality (products + bookings + new sub-tabs).

integration_issues.issue: After successful login as admin@test.com (PIN 153759) and redirect to /admin, opening /admin/mall (direct nav or via in-app link) shows only the purple 'Loading…' spinner. Console: two 403 responses; body text reduces to 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app. Loading...'. Likely culprit: webpack chunk '/static/js/admin.[hash].chunk.js' (or its index manifest) served 403 by ingress / stale service-worker (v89 reference in problem statement) caching mismatched chunk names after the recent rebuild.

action_items: Diagnose why /admin/mall lazy chunk returns 403. Likely causes: (a) service-worker v89 caching old index.html that references stale chunk filenames; (b) ingress/CDN rule blocking the freshly built admin chunk; (c) IS_USER_BUILD flag toggling AdminParasMall to null at runtime. Recommend: open browser DevTools → Network, capture the exact 403 URL; verify the chunk file exists on disk under /app/frontend/build/static/js/; inspect service-worker.js v89 caching strategy for chunk requests.
Until /admin/mall renders, the new Pending Delivery / Delivered / All Bookings sub-tab UI cannot be validated in any browser session — this is a release blocker.

After fix, re-run this iteration's flow: login → /admin/mall → click Bookings parent tab → verify the three sub-tabs, default active state, empty-state texts, parent pulsing badge, hint banner gating, and absence of Mark Delivered button on delivered rows.
critical_code_review_comments: Static review of AdminParasMall.js: implementation matches the PRD — default bookingsTab='pending_delivery'; pendingDeliveryBookings / deliveredBookings / visibleBookings derived correctly; sub-tab pills use the requested testids and active colour classes (bg-amber-500 / bg-blue-600 / bg-slate-700); parent 'Bookings' pill renders animate-pulse amber badge only when pendingDeliveryBookings.length > 0; empty-state has 3 differentiated copies via data-testid='admin-mall-bookings-empty'; Mark Delivered button correctly gated on b.status==='fulfilled', so delivered rows will NOT show it.

Minor: analytics tiles use a hard-coded slice(0,2) inside a map over ['mining','fulfilled','delivered'] — looks like an unintended limit that drops the 'delivered' tile from the grid. Worth confirming with main agent.
Minor: STATUS_COLORS lacks fallback for unknown b.status values; would render empty pill if a new status is introduced.
No data-testid on the analytics tiles or the bookings-subtabs container row — only the container has testid='admin-mall-bookings-subtabs'. Acceptable for current scope.

Once main agent fixes the chunk-serving 403, the existing test script in this conversation can be reused as-is to validate sub-tabs.
rca of the issue: RCA: /admin/mall route is wrapped in <Suspense fallback={<LoadingFallback/>}> around lazy(() => import('@/pages/Admin/AdminParasMall')). The dynamic import resolves to a webpack chunk that the server is returning 403 for. Symptoms: page text reduces to 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app. Loading...'; two 'Failed to load resource: 403' console errors at the moment of route entry; root [data-testid=admin-paras-mall] never mounts; subsequent selectors all time out. Reproduction: 1) login as admin@test.com / 153759, 2) navigate to /admin/mall, 3) observe Loading spinner indefinitely. Mitigation candidates: (a) bump service-worker version and force re-install + skipWaiting + clients.claim so stale chunk manifest is purged; (b) verify ingress rules / static-asset 403; (c) rebuild frontend so chunk filename in index.html matches what's on disk. The new Booking sub-tab code itself is not the cause — its parent route can't even mount.
